title: Which Hogwarts house are you? Free Harry Potter sorting quiz — cv.cm
description: Free Hogwarts house quiz: answer 12 questions to find out whether you belong in Gryffindor, Hufflepuff, Ravenclaw or Slytherin, with famous members of your house. No sign-up, unofficial fan quiz.
lede: Brave, loyal, clever or ambitious? Answer 12 questions about what you value and how you act, and find out where the Sorting Hat might put you.
about: In the Harry Potter books, every new student at Hogwarts is sorted into one of four houses: Gryffindor values courage, Hufflepuff loyalty and hard work, Ravenclaw wit and learning, and Slytherin ambition and cunning. Each question here offers one answer for each house.

Your result names your house, a few famous members and your scores for all four. This is an unofficial fan quiz written for cv.cm. It is not affiliated with or endorsed by J.K. Rowling, Warner Bros. or Wizarding World; the names belong to their owners.

faq.q: What are the four Hogwarts houses?
faq.a: Gryffindor (courage and nerve), Hufflepuff (loyalty, fairness and hard work), Ravenclaw (intelligence, wit and curiosity) and Slytherin (ambition, cunning and resourcefulness).
No. Slytherin has had its villains, but it is also the house of ambition and resourcefulness, and Merlin and Severus Snape were Slytherins. Every house has its heroes.

faq.q: What if I get two houses close together?
faq.a: That makes you a "hatstall", someone the Sorting Hat would think hard about. The Hat takes your choice into account, so pick the house that feels right.

faq.q: Is this the official sorting quiz?
faq.a: No. It is a free fan quiz, and your answers stay in your browser.

items.q: Which quality matters most to you?
Pick a place to spend an afternoon:
options: A tower library with a view
A lakeside room lit green by the water
A sports field on match day

items.q: A friend breaks a rule and you find out. You…
options: Stand by them and help put it right
Ask whether the rule made sense in the first place
Tell them to their face that it was wrong
Keep quiet: they'll owe you one

items.q: What would you most like to be remembered for?
options: Doing the right thing when it was hard
An idea that changed how people think
You'll bend the rules to win
You find it hard to say no

items.q: A dragon blocks your path. You…
options: Study it to find a weakness
Strike a deal with someone who can handle it
Get everyone to safety first, then work it out together
A broomstick faster than any other
A wand that never loses a duel
A cup that never runs empty, for sharing
A book that answers any question

items.q: How do you prepare for a big exam?
options: Steady work every day, with a study group
Reading far beyond the syllabus, for fun
Working out what the examiners want and focusing on that
A late night before, and trusting your nerve

items.q: Which would you hate to be called?
Pick a motto for your friends:

gryffindor.name: Gryffindor
gryffindor.body: Brave, bold and quick to stand up for what's right. You act when others hesitate and you'd walk into danger for a friend. Just count to three before you charge. Famous Gryffindors: Harry Potter, Hermione Granger, Ron Weasley and Albus Dumbledore.

hufflepuff.name: Hufflepuff
hufflepuff.body: Loyal, fair and hard-working, the friend everyone can count on. You treat people kindly, you never cut corners and you don't need the spotlight. Famous Hufflepuffs: Cedric Diggory, Newt Scamander and Nymphadora Tonks.

ravenclaw.name: Ravenclaw
ravenclaw.body: Curious, clever and original. You love ideas for their own sake, ask questions nobody else thinks of and don't mind being a little different. Famous Ravenclaws: Luna Lovegood, Cho Chang and Filius Flitwick.

slytherin.name: Slytherin
slytherin.body: Ambitious, resourceful and determined. You know what you want and find clever ways to get it, and you're fiercely loyal to your own people. Famous Slytherins: Merlin, Severus Snape and Horace Slughorn.
